name: FORENZA Cloudflare & Edge WAF Specification
description: OWASP CRS v3.3 Tuned WAF rules with search engine whitelisting and zero legitimate user friction.

overrides.description: Challenge rather than hard block on borderline SQLi heuristics to protect scientific DNA queries
Managed challenge on borderline XSS heuristics

custom_firewall_rules.description: Allow verified search engine bots and accessibility spiders without friction
custom_firewall_rules.expression: cf.client.bot or (ip.geoip.asnum in {15169, 8075, 32934} and http.user_agent contains ("Googlebot", "Bingbot", "DuckDuckBot", "Applebot"))

custom_firewall_rules.description: Immediately block malicious scanner probes (.env, .git, config files)
custom_firewall_rules.expression: http.request.uri.path contains ".env" or http.request.uri.path contains ".git/" or http.request.uri.path contains "/etc/passwd"

custom_firewall_rules.description: Rate-limit and challenge abnormal payload sizes to ZKP verification endpoints
